title: Campaign Lifecycle Scenario Terminal Output (W10-A4)
description: Terminal output contract for the Campaign Lifecycle Scenario. The Human director stage emits a director decision (output.decision) which, together with the upstream stage outputs, composes the scenario's terminal production. The scenario terminates in one of two statuses (campaign-approved, campaign-rejected). This document is the contract behind the scenario's outputContractRef (campaign.output.v1).

decision.description: The director's sign-off decision emitted by the human-director-approval stage.
